facts.text: cube-transfer-v1 is registered with entry point gym_av_aloha.env.tasks.cube_transfer_env:CubeTransferEnv
The registration marks cube-transfer-v1 nondeterministic=True because rendered observations differ even after seeding
The default camera set has six cameras, each rendered at 480x640 pixels
AVAlohaEnv adds a pixels observation only when len(cameras) > 0
AV_STATE_DIM is 21 and AV_ACTION_DIM is 21; STATE_DIM and ACTION_DIM are 14
With enable_av=True the action space is a Box with low -inf, high inf and shape (action_dim,)
The agent_pos observation is a Box with low -inf, high inf and shape (state_dim,), and the observation space is a Dict
With enable_av=True get_obs builds agent_pos from the left joint positions, left gripper, right joint positions, right gripper and middle joint positions
CubeTransferEnv adds an environment_state Box with shape (ENV_STATE_DIM,) to the observation and rebuilds the observation space as a Dict
ENV_STATE_DIM is 7
CubeTransferEnv.get_obs sets environment_state to the bound cube joint qpos, a 7-value pose
CubeTransferEnv sets max_reward to 4
CubeTransferEnv.get_reward returns a reward from 0 to 4 from cube, gripper and table contacts
reset(seed, options) passes seed and options to gym.Env.reset, resets the physics, optionally randomizes the light and prompt, restores the fixed arm poses and returns observation and info
CubeTransferEnv.reset draws the cube position uniformly from x [-0.05, 0.05], y [0.05, 0.15], z 0 with the global np.random generator
step applies the action as control over n_ctrl_steps, each advancing SIM_PHYSICS_ENV_STEP_RATIO physics steps, and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info
terminated is reward == max_reward and info is_success is the same comparison
SIM_PHYSICS_DT is 0.002 s and SIM_DT is 0.04 s from 20 physics steps
The default fps is 25
step_dt is 1/fps and n_ctrl_steps is round(step_dt/SIM_DT)
SimRobotArm.set_joint_ctrl clips joint control to the actuator ctrlrange
The environment's render_fps is 1/SIM_DT and its only render mode is rgb_array
The upstream package requires Python ^3.10 and mujoco 3.3.3, dm-control ^1.0.31 and datasets 3.3.2

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds gymnasium's np_random, but CubeTransferEnv.reset draws the cube position from the global np.random generator (cube_transfer_env.py:94-105), so upstream seed control is imperfect for that draw; the fake uses Python's random.Random(seed) for the cube pose and a fixed arm pose, so it repeats a trajectory for one seed.  The registration declares the default rendered setup nondeterministic (__init__.py:22-24); this driver configures cameras={} and makes no claim about rendered frames.

gaps: the fake backend is kinematic: it stores the 21-value action as the agent_pos observation and a 7-value cube pose as environment_state; it has no MuJoCo rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise, while the upstream environment integrates 20 physics steps of 2 ms per step

pixel observations are NOT COVERED: the registered default renders six 480x640 RGB cameras (480x640x3 per camera); this driver configures cameras={} and the fake returns no pixels, so vision and the lighting model are not modelled
reward and termination are simplified: the fake returns reward 0 and never terminates, while CubeTransferEnv computes 0 to 4 from cube, gripper and table contacts and terminates at max_reward 4
action clipping is not modelled: SimRobotArm clips joint control to the actuator ctrlrange and the grippers to 0..1, while the fake applies the commanded unbounded action values directly
reset options (randomize_light, prompt, distractors) are accepted and ignored by the fake; only the seeded cube placement and the fixed arm pose are modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: AVAlohaEnv has set_state but no get_state/get_state_dict pair, so the bridge cannot snapshot
the fake was not compared with a real MuJoCo run: mujoco 3.3.3 and dm-control 1.0.31 are not installed where the gate runs, and no physical device is modelled

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
